title: Long exact cohomology sequence of a distinguished triangle in the derived category
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category, $D(\mathcal C)$ its derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and $H^n:D(\mathcal C)	o\mathcal C$ the $n$-th cohomology functor (the cohomology of a representing complex). For every distinguished triangle $X\xrightarrow{u}Y\xrightarrow{v}Z\xrightarrow{w}X[1]$ there are connecting morphisms $\delta^n:H^n(Z)	o H^{n+1}(X)$ such that the sequence
$$
\cdots	o H^n(X)\xrightarrow{H^n(u)}H^n(Y)\xrightarrow{H^n(v)}H^n(Z)\xrightarrow{\delta^n}H^{n+1}(X)	o\cdots
$$
is exact.
